sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety candidates for the 2026-06-14 to 2026-06-21 window; GateMem was selected after local duplicate checks.
Main agent read the arXiv metadata, full 24-page PDF text, and official GitHub README; the article extracts metrics, baseline mechanisms, tables, formulas, and failure cases.
Article is pure Markdown with more than 5000 Chinese characters, no frontmatter, no external image embeds, and local evidence expressed as tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid.
